description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractFromCommandJsonDeserializer that implements the FromCommandJsonDeserializer interface. It provides basic implementations of methods for converting JSON strings into command objects, to be extended by concrete subclasses for specific command types.

classes.name: AbstractFromCommandJsonDeserializer
classes.description: An abstract class that provides default implementations for command deserialization methods, intended to be extended for specific command types.

methods.name: commandFromCommandJson(String commandAsJson)
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a command object without a codeId, delegates to the overloaded method.

methods.name: commandFromCommandJson(Long codeId, String commandAsJson)
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a command object with an optional codeId, delegates to another method with an additional parameter.
